lineage: Claims to be a closed group (not RaaS); collaboration with North Korean Jumpy Pisces/Andariel reported (2024)
summary: Play has hit ~900 organisations since mid-2022. Entry is via edge exploits (FortiOS, Exchange ProxyNotShell/OWASSRF, Cisco ASA, SimpleHelp CVE-2024-57727) or valid VPN/RDP accounts. Operators use the custom Grixba scanner/infostealer, AdFind, SystemBC/Cobalt Strike, GMER/IOBit/PowerTool to kill AV, WinRAR+WinSCP for chunked exfiltration, and an intermittent encryptor for Windows and ESXi; ransom notes carry no demand and point to unique gmx.de/web.de mailboxes, with phone-call pressure.
uniqueTraits: Grixba custom .NET network scanner / infostealer and AlphaVSS-based VSS Copying Tool
Exchange ProxyNotShell/OWASSRF and SimpleHelp RMM CVE-2024-57727 exploitation
Windows CLFS zero-day CVE-2025-29824 used for privilege escalation
Intermittent encryption; demand-less ransom notes with per-victim @gmx.de/@web.de addresses
ESXi Linux locker using vim-cmd/esxcli to power off VMs

chain.noAtomicReason: Local catalogue has no T1190 exploit atomic (and plans never add exploit code); validate with perimeter/WAF/appliance log detections instead.
